card.name: Court names in legal case citations
card.fires_on: Punctuation and short words inside US court citations, such as the opening parenthesis before a district abbreviation, "the" after "Court of Appeals for", and "Cir" in "Fed. Cir.".

modes.label: Court citation parentheses
modes.description: The opening parenthesis or first letter of a district court abbreviation after a case reporter number.
modes.example: t. v. Tyson Fresh Meats, Inc., 315 F. Supp. 2d 1172<< (>>M.D. Ala. 20

modes.label: Appeals court names
modes.description: The word "the" after "Court of Appeals for" or "Upon reaching", just before a named court.
modes.example: of cattle. The cattlemen appealed. On December 17, oral arguments in the case were heard by the United States Court of Appeals for<< the>> Eleventh Circuit.

modes.label: Federal Circuit abbreviation
modes.description: Parts of "Fed. Cir." inside a case citation.
